args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following the latest production deploy of v2.3.1. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production, and rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback was verified as rolled out across all regions. Action needed: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures before attempting redeploy.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** — found that v2.3.1 (the latest production deploy) is unhealthy, and the most recent healthy production release is **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** — rolled out and verified in all production regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west. No change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** — documents the v2.3.1 health check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up: investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures before redeploying that version.
